boxes.meaning: person of the same rank or level

examples.english: He is my equal, so I don't need to be especially deferential to him.
examples.traditional: 佢係我嘅同級，唔使對佢特別客氣。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tung4 kap1 m4 sai2 deoi3 keoi5 dak6 bit6 haak3 hei3

examples.english: That company is our peer; there is no hierarchy between us.
examples.traditional: 嗰間公司同我哋係同級，唔存在上下級之分。
examples.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 tung4 ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 kap1 m4 cyun4 zoi6 soeng6 haa6 kap1 zi1 fan1
